description: This Java class implements a service to read buy-down fee amortization details for a specific loan in the Fineract platform. It validates the loan's existence and feature enablement before retrieving and mapping fee balances to data transfer objects.

classes.name: BuyDownFeeReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a service for retrieving buy-down fee amortization details related to loans.

methods.name: retrieveLoanBuyDownFeeAmortizationDetails
methods.description: Retrieves and maps buy-down fee balances for a given loan ID after validation.

methods.name: mapToLoanBuyDownFeeAmortizationData
methods.description: Maps a LoanBuyDownFeeBalance object to a BuyDownFeeAmortizationDetails DTO.
